{"metadata":{"description":"Native Windows toast + taskbar flash for DeepSeek Harness when a task finishes or your input is needed.","id":"gh:1334868392","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-notify-win","slug":"Andyqwe44/dsh-notify-win","topics":["dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","taskbar-flash","toast"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Native Windows toast + taskbar flash for DeepSeek Harness when a task finishes or your input is need"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ive Windows toast + taskbar flash for DeepSeek Harness when a task finishes or your input is needed."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-notify-win"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Windows notification plugin — native toast + taskbar flash when a task fini"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"shes or your input is needed."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## 📸 Screenshots"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## ✨ Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- 🔔 **Native Windows toast** (bottom-right, Win10/11 system style)
- 💡 **Taskbar flash** (`FlashWind"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"owEx`) when DSH is in the background; the OS stops it as soon as DSH comes to the foreground
- 🖱️ **"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"Click-to-focus** — clicking a toast opens DSH and switches to the corresponding session
- ✅ Triggers"},{"id":"p7s4","text":" when a **task finishes** (root agent goes `idle`)
- 🧭 **Tells you WHY it stopped** — the toast refl"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"ects the `turn/end` reason instead of always claiming success: normal finish, output-token ceiling ("},{"id":"p7s6","text":"`max-tokens`), blocked pre-step, LLM failure (provider-neutral code + retry count), or cancellation."},{"id":"p7s7","text":" See Stop conditions.
- 🗜️ Triggers when **context compaction finishes** — and alerts when it **fail"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"s** (`compaction/end` with `error`)
- ❓ Triggers when **your input is needed** (approval / `ask_user"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"_question`)
- 📋 **Question toast with pages**: a single question shows its native dropdown (up to 5 "},{"id":"p7s10","text":"options) plus a custom-answer text box. Two or more questions become one paged toast (`问题 i/n` + 上一题"},{"id":"p7s11","text":" / 下一题 / 提交 / 取消); every page keeps its dropdown choice and custom text when you page back, and a `已"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"答：…` line keeps the other answers visible.
- 🧷 **Resident helper, plugin lifetime**: one `dsh-toast-"},{"id":"p7s13","text":"question.exe` is started when the plugin is applied and reused for every question. Disabling the plu"},{"id":"p7s14","text":"gin or quitting DSH shuts it down (stdio EOF when DSH exits), so no per-question process spawn and n"},{"id":"p7s15","text":"o orphan process.
- ✅ **One honest receipt**: submitting closes the question toast; nothing else pop"},{"id":"p7s16","text":"s up until the model answers, and then exactly one toast appears — the **model's first line**, fille"},{"id":"p7s17","text":"d to the toast width and cut with `…` when it is longer (no “已提交” / “已送达” / “已收到并回应” stages, no titl"},{"id":"p7s18","text":"e line). Text that can only exist if the whole round trip really happened. If the model produces no "},{"id":"p7s19","text":"visible text, nothing is shown (no invented receipt). Cancelling says “没有向 DSH 提交任何答案”; a card that "},{"id":"p7s20","text":"could not be filled says “请在 DSH 窗口中手动回答”.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- Windows 10/11 (x64)
- DeepSeek Harness, any profile (`web` recommended)
- .NET 10 Desktop Runtime "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"(x64) — **required**: the resident toast helper is the only notification implementation. All toasts "},{"id":"p9s3","text":"(done / compact / alert / notice, interactive approval and questions) go through it. Install with `w"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"inget install Microsoft.DotNet.DesktopRuntime.10` or from <https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dot"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"net/10.0>. No PowerShell script is used."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Concern | Implementation |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Trigger "done"/alert/notice | `session/event` → `turn/end` reason cache + `agent/status` `idle` (r"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"oot agents only) |
| Trigger "compact" / compaction failure | `session/event` → `compaction/end` |
|"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" Trigger "question" | `approval/request` waterfall (toast + DSH panel) + `tools/execute` for `ask_us"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"er_question` |
| Done/compact/alert/notice toast | Resident .NET helper `notify` op; WinRT `Windows."},{"id":"p12s5","text":"UI.Notifications`, `NotifyIcon` balloon fallback. No per-notification process |
| Interactive approv"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"al toast | DSH's own approval panel still shows; the toast is a remote control using the same `quest"},{"id":"p12s7","text":"ion` op: one fixed-choice card (`允许一次` / `拒绝`, no free-text input). Its answer is parked for the bro"},{"id":"p12s8","text":"wser half, which switches to the owning session and clicks the panel; the panel remains the authorit"},{"id":"p12s9","text":"y. Cancelling the toast leaves the decision to the panel, and an aborted turn retires the toast |
| "},{"id":"p12s10","text":"Interactive question toast | Resident .NET helper `question` op, spoken to over the child's stdin/st"},{"id":"p12s11","text":"dout (newline-delimited JSON). One question = one card; several questions = one paged card (`问题 i/n`"},{"id":"p12s12","text":", 上一题/下一题/提交), with each page's draft restored through the toast `defaultInput` attribute |
| Questi"},{"id":"p12s13","text":"on answer receipt | The helper reports the selection and dismisses the question toast; the host park"},{"id":"p12s14","text":"s it for the browser half, checks the `ask_user_question` tool result, then shows exactly one toast "},{"id":"p12s15","text":"— `spoken` with the model's first line (filled to the toast width, cut with `…`). No pending, delive"},{"id":"p12s16","text":"red or title toast |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- Native toast text is compact: only about 4 lines are displayed, so long content is truncated.
- Th"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"e native selection dropdown may collapse when the pointer moves onto the popup; if the toast is then"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" dismissed by timeout, the taskbar flash still reminds you, and it stops once DSH is foreground.
- T"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"he .NET 10 Desktop Runtime is a hard requirement. Without it the helper cannot start and no notifica"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"tion can be shown; the host logs an explicit error. There is no PowerShell fallback.
- The helper is"},{"id":"p14s6","text":" a single long-lived process. If it crashes, the next notification asks the host to spawn it again; "},{"id":"p14s7","text":"until then, notifications are dropped with a log line.
- `FlashWindowEx` uses the system's warm-puls"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"e highlight; custom colors are not possible.
- Windows never flashes the foreground window — the tas"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"kbar button only flashes when DSH is in the background; an active flash is stopped by the OS when th"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"e window comes to the foreground.
- A cancelled turn is reported as "cancelled" (not "task complete""},{"id":"p14s11","text":"); set `notifyOnCancel: false` to silence it, or `notifyOnError: false` to silence abnormal-stop ale"},{"id":"p14s12","text":"rts.
- Notifications are deduplicated per session within `dedupMs` (default 1500 ms). A second `idle"},{"id":"p14s13","text":"` for an already-reported turn stays quiet.
- Multi-question toasts page by re-showing the native to"},{"id":"p14s14","text":"ast. Windows animates the old toast out and the new one in, so each page change has a short visual g"},{"id":"p14s15","text":"ap; the `已答` line carries the context across it. Multi-question cards always use the long duration ("},{"id":"p14s16","text":"about 25 s).
- A custom answer wins over the dropdown selection on the same page, exactly like the p"},{"id":"p14s17","text":"revious single-question toast; clear the text box if you only want the dropdown choice.
- The receip"},{"id":"p14s18","text":"t cannot be faked by the UI: “spoken” is the model's own first line (cut with … to fit one toast lin"},{"id":"p14s19","text":"e) and is the only toast shown after submitting. If the model produces no visible text (for example "},{"id":"p14s20","text":"it immediately calls another tool), no receipt toast appears at all.
